Kit summary

Wildfire ShotActive
Deals 450% ATK Burn DMG to one enemy and inflicts Loong's Wrath for 2 turns.
Duskfire Heavy Cannon Lv.1When it hits an enemy with Loong's Wrath, gains 1 Ammunition.
Duskfire Heavy Cannon Lv.3Cast 5 times immediately whenever Twilight Annihilation - Resonance is cast.
Heavy Fire PursuitActive
Deals 500% ATK Burn DMG to one enemy and inflicts Loong's Wrath for 2 turns. Under Resonance Enhancement it becomes Heavy Fire Pursuit - Resonance: deals 500% ATK Burn DMG to one enemy, and if the target has Loong's Wrath, deals an additional 500% ATK Burn DMG and gains 5 Ammunition.
Duskfire Heavy Cannon Lv.1When it hits an enemy with Loong's Wrath, gains 1 Ammunition.
Wanderer's EchoPassive
All of Boone's DMG counts as Resonance DMG. Max 20 Resonance Points: gains 1 when an enemy is inflicted with Loong's Wrath (1 extra for a Boss); none can be gained during Resonance Enhancement. At max points he gains 50% Turn Meter and enters Resonance Enhancement for 2 turns: gains 10 Ammunition, Heavy Fire Pursuit and Twilight Annihilation CD -1 turn, and both are replaced by their Resonance versions. While enhanced, each time controlled he consumes 5 Ammunition to remove the control and gain 20% Turn Meter.
Duskfire Heavy Cannon Lv.2Can gain Resonance Points during Resonance Enhancement, and enters it at battle start. Gains 10 Resonance Points when other allies inflict Loong's Wrath on a Boss, and 1 Ammunition when an ally inflicts Loong's Wrath. With 5 Loong's Wrath allies deployed (while enhanced): when an enemy inflicts control, casts Twilight Annihilation once and inflicts Pacifist (Mastery -50%, Crit DMG -50%) on all enemies for 2 turns (once per action); when an ally is controlled, consumes 5 Ammunition to remove it and gives that ally +50% Turn Meter; when an ally's HP falls below 80%, consumes 5 Ammunition to give them a Shield (2000% of Boone's ATK) for 2 turns and +25% Turn Meter (up to twice before his action).
Duskfire Heavy Cannon Lv.3Upon entering Resonance Enhancement, removes all Block Debuffs from enemies and casts Twilight Annihilation once.
Twilight AnnihilationUltimate
Gains 5 Ammunition, deals 600% ATK Burn DMG to all enemies and inflicts 1 layer of Loong's Wrath for 2 turns. Resonance version: consumes all Ammunition to deal (600% ATK + 50% ATK per Ammunition consumed) Burn DMG to all enemies, ignoring Shield, then grants all allies an unremovable Shield (200% of Boone's ATK per Ammunition consumed) for 2 turns.
Duskfire Heavy Cannon Lv.3When Loong's Wrath allies are hit by a Boss's basic attack or skill, Boone counterattacks with Twilight Annihilation (once before his action). Each cast gives the highest-ATK ally +25% Turn Meter and removes their debuffs (once before his action). DMG coefficient +200% per Loong's Wrath ally deployed, and DMG to Bosses +150% per Resonance ally deployed. When the Resonance version Shields a Loong's Wrath ally, each Ammunition consumed also gives them +5% Mastery and Crit DMG for 2 turns (up to 10 times).
Duskfire Heavy Cannon (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
